foreground: Visible cartons, crates and stored or transported goods, including goods on shelves or robots
background: Robot bodies, shelf structure, floor, walls, people and transport equipment
uncertainty: Mark ambiguous identity, occlusion boundaries and unresolvable pixels as ignore; do not infer hidden surfaces
reference_limitations: Candidate masks are predictions. Correction is model-assisted and may retain anchoring bias. Frame counts are pilot requirements, not statistical adequacy guarantees.
test_policy: Do not prepare or use held-out test labels until the candidate and evaluation protocol are frozen
